page.layout: One title page: a printed text block centred inside a double-ruled frame and an ornamental woodcut border. Below the frame, the imprint line. Library stamps and handwriting in the top margin are not transcribed.

main_text.l: IV. De Usu ejus communi & publico.
FAC. THEOL. BASIL. p. t. DECANO,

l.i: Hoc ipso ordine respondebunt sequentes Ministerii

page.notes: Ornamental border and the engraved rule frame are not text. The library stamp and the handwritten shelf marks are not transcribed. The text is set in roman capitals and small capitals, with the title lines in italic. Printed "V" for vowel u and "Q" with tail for Q are normalised per the rules (DISPUTATIONUM, QUA, USU). The printed "IOHANNE" is given as JOHANNE, the initial consonant I being read as J.
